decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete standalone main-board layer count and limits the retained legacy fact to the superseded architecture.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete standalone main-board dimensions and prototype dimension rule while recording their supersession.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully records the single-board architecture, changes the board count to one, and removes the obsolete separate-board list.

The existing same-message MODIFY removes the obsolete interboard-connector orientation and records elimination of interboard connectors; the remaining external connector-access constraints are not necessarily changed.

The existing same-message MODIFY removes all obsolete interboard alignment, cable-routing, and separate-board connector-layout attributes and retains only the operational fact that the requirement was eliminated.
The existing same-message MODIFY already adapts the architecture-dependent wording and scope to the integrated board while preserving the explicitly requested functionality.
The existing same-message MODIFY directly and fully captures the single-board, reduced-connector, JLCPCB Basic-component, and cost-optimization decision.
The existing MODIFY removes the obsolete separate-board activation condition but leaves the equally obsolete main-board location attribute after all functions move onto one integrated board.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I was thinking, if you have time for a new project and are willing to do it, that we try to make as cheap as possible single board for this project. So everything will be on one board and from start we try to match JLCPCB Basica component (as much as possible). It will have much less connectors as there are no interboard connectors. Also if you have some idea on how to make something better/cheaper but have same functionality you can suggest. I can add it as new milestone to this project and we can agree on price. What do you think does it make sense?

value_updates.source_selection: Schottky-diode OR-ing selects the available source; AXP2101 DCDC1 is programmed to 3.4V before the diode so the system rail remains at 3.3V.
value_updates.normal_operation_source: AXP2101 DCDC1 programmed to 3.4V via I2C before the integrated-board Schottky OR-ing drop
